name: strings
title: String processing
measures: Concatenation, searching, prefix checks, splitting, joining, and replacing, on ASCII text.
notes: ASCII only, so RuneScript's byte lengths and offsets equal TypeScript's UTF-16 ones (C13 covers non-ASCII text). TypeScript 1.0's library has no startsWith or repeat: the TS version uses indexOf/lastIndexOf and split/join, as 2014 code would.
